Features
Keystroke Pasting

Types answers into Monaco editors with indentation options.

Voice & Tone Controls

Choose voice gender and tone to match the scenario.

System Audio Support

Use with Zoom or YouTube; captures system audio when needed.

Real-time Transcription

Get accurate live transcripts while you speak.

Overlay Panel

Logging & Diagnostics

Hotkeys

Privacy
